hypotheses.reasoning: search-api's old gen keeps filling and full GC can't reclaim it (78% at #74, then 87% at #108). It then hits OutOfMemoryError in productCache.put (#135, #151) and gets OOMKilled at the 2Gi limit, restarting twice (#136, #152). During each restart web-bff gets connection resets and 'no healthy upstream', which shows up as bursts of 502s (#141, #164, #172, #198). The 'warming product cache' line after restart suggests the cache has no size limit and fills up again. catalog-svc, catalog-db and redis logged no errors. The index-worker DLQ message (#81) is a separate, harmless event.
v4.15.1 could have introduced the unbounded cache, but no deploy event appears in this log window.

verdict.recommendedAction: Stop the restart loop first: raise search-api's memory limit or heap size, or add replicas, so requests keep a healthy upstream. Then cap productCache with a maximum size and LRU/TTL eviction, take a heap dump to confirm the leak, and check whether v4.15.1 changed how the cache works. Roll back if it did.
